item.title: Nicole Kidman Didn’t Make It to That Bonkers Playoff Game, But She Sure Loved Este Haim’s Custom ‘Knickole Kidman’ Knicks T-shirt
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dish out the latest celebrity news and trends. And today, we're talking about the New York Knicks' thrilling last-second victory in game four of the NBA finals. The crowd was electric, with A-listers like Taylor Swift and the Haim sisters cheering on the team in style."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Haim sisters, Este and Alana, showed up to the game in custom Knicks-themed T-shirts, complete with punny names like 'Stevie Knicks' and 'Knickole Kidman'. And they weren't alone - Taylor Swift and even Law & Order star Mariska Hargitay joined in on the fun, wearing matching 'Stevie Knicks' shirts."
[Short clip of crowd cheering]
Host: "According to Alana Haim, the idea for the custom shirts came from a text from Taylor Swift, who wanted a music-related Knicks pun. And the rest, as they say, is history. Alana even revealed that she screen-printed the shirts herself, after buying them from Michael's for just $2.99 each."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Nicole Kidman, who couldn't make it to the game, took to Instagram to show her support for the trio, reposting their celebration video and writing 'My girls! I just wanna have fun!' And it looks like they definitely had a blast, dancing to Cyndi Lauper's classic hit 'Girls Just Want to Have Fun'."
[Short clip of "Girls Just Want to Have Fun" playing]
Host: "The Knicks' improbable win has taken them to a 3-1 lead in the series, and they're just one game away from their first championship in 53 years. Will they take it all the way? We'll have to wait and see. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
[Outro music plays]
